C0197.title: Tampermonkey Script for Bulk Unfollowing on Weibo
C0197.summary: Public user-script indexes include Tampermonkey-based scripts designed to automate bulk unfollowing on Weibo. Although the platform provides native account-management features, these scripts turn repeated manual selection into automated browser actions for cleaning large following lists.
